protocol.name: Fit-only nonparametric response baseline
protocol.status: frozen before cross-validation and held-out scoring
protocol.purpose: test whether local interpolation can recover held-out physical response curves better than D9b without changing the input representation
protocol.scope: TRAIN only; 218 fit groups for model selection and 38 previously held-out TRAIN groups for one final score; DEV and TEST closed

features.action: fit-normalized endpoint-symmetric pair mean and absolute difference over eight visible action steps and six levels

selection.fold_rule: sorted fit episode ids assigned round-robin by index modulo five; every validation fold is episode-disjoint
selection.criterion: lowest pooled cross-validated mean squared error over every 6-by-41 log-response value
selection.tie_break: candidate order as listed: state weight, then neighbor count, then kernel

prediction.uniform: arithmetic mean of k nearest physical log-response curves
prediction.inverse_distance: distance-inverse weighted mean; if any distance is exactly zero, average only zero-distance neighbors

interpretation.local_rule_beats_d9b: held-out mean curve MSE improves by at least 10 percent and either boundary or final agreement is no worse, with neither added-positive rate increasing by more than 0.05; prioritize neural architecture/objective repair
interpretation.otherwise: the fixed state/action metric and fit data do not locally identify held-out response; prioritize denser generic response data or generic temporal/contact history
